Black, blue and white geometric Be kind design; abstract halo back, owl/jester sides.
Bright multicolour repaint for first post-pandemic DGTL edition.

timeline.meaning: Love, strength, acceptance and solidarity within the LGBTQIA+ community.

timeline.artists: VAAF — Lotte Masker and Jonna Bo Lammers

timeline.currentEvidence: Operator current exhibition listing and three labelled 2026 original photographs; retrieved 2026-10-06. Not a claimed same-day on-site survey.

assertions.assertion: The arch originated at DGTL in 2018 and remained as a changing public installation.
FIRESTARTER is the operator-listed current artwork from 03 Apr 2026 to 03 Apr 2027.
Current repaint credited to Gabi Brunhoso; commissioned by Stichting NDSM-werf in cooperation with DGTL; photos by Gert Jan van Rooij.

Current photographs show a purple structural frame and dark inward surfaces, turquoise broad side panels, bright magenta ribbon forms, yellow/orange accent shapes and dense coloured corrugation stripes.
Nine separate container volumes form the polygonal arch; open centre and visible wedge gaps must survive.

artworkPolicy: Use original texture-free flat-colour geometric motifs derived from supported shape/color observations. Do not copy photo pixels or imported artwork assets. Do not add identification words. Any retained tiny creator signature needs actual wall/panel placement; omitting it is preferable to invented signage.
